# Erugo theme palette attribution

The owner requested the bundled Erugo theme choices. The palette reference in erugo-theme-reference.json was extracted from the bundled themes shipped with Erugo 0.2.15, available from https://github.com/ErugoOSS/Erugo. It contains visual palette data only, no company-specific themes, accounts, credentials or uploaded assets.

Copyright (c) 2025 Dean Ward. The upstream MIT license is reproduced in full in ERUGO-LICENSE.txt and must accompany these derived palettes.

Passelio maps the palette roles to its own interface in themes.py. Some text/accent/button colors are adjusted to retain at least 4.5:1 main foreground contrast. Gradients are generated only from validated hex colors; upstream CSS strings, shadows, dimensions and executable content are not imported. The result preserves the theme choices and color families, not pixel-identical Erugo rendering.

Names retained for identification: Erugo, Erugo 2026, Heather, Sakura, Aqua, Colbolt, Dracula, Github Light, Tropical Sunset, Parma Violet, CyberNeon Flux, Amethyst, Galaxy and Cave Dweller. This is not an endorsement or affiliation with Erugo.
